criteria.label: Initiation and need for a push
criteria.definition: Beginning chores/work/tasks, difficulty starting and reliance on an external push.
criteria.high_evidence: Starts promptly and readily, even through ordinary reluctance; does not require a push.
criteria.low_evidence: Delays or struggles to begin, or needs a push before starting.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Using a calendar is not automatically low. An external resource constraint alone is not a disposition.

criteria.label: Persistence and carrying plans through
criteria.definition: Following an intended activity through its steps and completion.
criteria.high_evidence: Carries an intended plan through, including dull remaining steps.
criteria.low_evidence: Lets an intended plan lapse or fails to complete it despite still wanting its result.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Goal prestige, moral duty and neatness are not substitutes; completion may coexist with delayed initiation.

criteria.label: Time use and distraction
criteria.definition: Time slipping away on diversions relative to one’s own intended use.
criteria.high_evidence: Keeps or returns attention to intended use and avoids habitual unwanted time loss.
criteria.low_evidence: Describes wasting intended time, drifting to diversions or losing track of it.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Enjoyed chosen rest is not automatically waste. Self-described habitual unwanted time loss counts without an unfinished-task claim.

criteria.label: Preparedness
criteria.definition: Being ready with what an ordinary activity calls for, beyond merely liking tidiness.
criteria.high_evidence: Usually has needed materials, details or arrangements ready.
criteria.low_evidence: Often arrives or begins unprepared, with needed basics missing or unarranged.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Preparedness is keyed even without a start failure. C2 order and C6 planning overlaps are flags, not exclusions.

criteria.label: Decision postponement
criteria.definition: Settling or repeatedly postponing decisions, apart from task initiation.
criteria.high_evidence: Makes an adequately informed ordinary choice rather than putting it off.
criteria.low_evidence: Leaves an ordinary decision pending or keeps deferring it.
criteria.mixed_or_null: 0 requires literal balanced/opposed evidence within this dimension. Null is absent/inapplicable evidence; do not infer low from absence. Careful thinking can coexist with habitual delay; a single warranted wait for information alone is ambiguous.

boundary_controls.definition: Separate obeying the experiment response format from the person’s depicted habits, ability, distress or social behavior.
External lack of access, imposed role or one-off conditions alone are ambiguous. Explicit habitual target content can coexist with these; do not automatically null it.
Preparedness and postponed decisions are retained even with C2/C6 overlap; tidiness or lengthy consideration alone cannot substitute.
Chosen rest and inaccessible materials alone are ambiguous. Explicit unwanted time waste, habitual postponement or difficult initiation counts without a diagnosis.

evidence_allocation_policy: Each dimension receives at most one grade. Allocate a shared passage to its best-fitting primary dimension; leave overlapping slots null unless there is a genuinely distinct clause or evidence. Multiple item links and subcontents within a dimension do not create extra grades. Contradictory subcontents within the same dimension require justified mixed/qualified grading, not duplicated opposite scores. Assess all dimensions with distinct evidence, not only the question’s assigned primary.
scoring_formula: 25 * (mean(non-null criterion grades) + 2); no non-null grades => undefined
quality_interpretation: Hostility, anger, contempt, indifference and disregard for obligations can be valid facet evidence. quality.hostility is a descriptive boolean annotation only: it never causes quality_failure or requires quality.evidence. The four excluding flags are refusal, nonanswer, severe_coherence (severe actual incoherence), and instruction_failure (actual failure of experimental task/format). Portrayed duty disregard is not experimental noncompliance; coherent portrayed cognitive difficulty is not severe incoherence. Each true excluding flag needs literal quality evidence. Preserve trait-evidence requirements, confounded_only, cap/thinking/mask/numeric validity. Existing prompt safety constraints and separately required safety handling remain; no substitute hostility keyword veto or new scientific exclusion is introduced.
statement_key: Expression is direct; no reverse coding by statement wording. A category alone is not enough.
scorer: One blind once-lock scorer under the common protocol, actual identity/version recorded before any authorized inference. No additional execution rater, adjudication or author scoring of model answers.

approved_eligibility_amendment.change: Hostility removed from automatic eligibility exclusion
